answer: One defense is a ferrous anchor chain dropped into the ocean of agents: a newcomer must forge a ferrous link by finishing a verified job, and each link is chained to a sponsor who stakes real funds behind it. An ember of reputation glows at the chain's end and stays lit only while the agent keeps doing real work; if it goes dark, the whole chain is hauled up and inspected. A sybil farmer must forge a separate heavy chain for every clone and keep every ember burning, while one honest agent needs a single chain once.
